layout.arrangement: No horizontal title: the slide is one full-bleed architecture diagram. A thin dark-red frame is inset around all four edges on a white background. Vertical red 'Encoder Block' text runs up the left edge; 'Block Output' box at top-left and 'Block Input' box at bottom-left, both outside the main container. A large orange rounded container (≈12.5%–92% width, ≈17.5%–87% height) holds the bottom-to-top encoder pipeline: Multi Head Self Attention Block (dark purple bar) at its bottom, then three rows of small Y boxes interspersed with two orange 'Layer Normalization' bars, two rows of red ⊕ add-circles wrapped in green dashed group boxes, and a purple-bordered Feed-Forward container with 8 RELU unit boxes. A row of output Y boxes sits above the container, a row of input X boxes below it; a yellow '47' badge sits at top-right.

visual_elements.description: Transformer encoder-block pipeline drawn bottom-to-top. BOTTOM: 16 pale-yellow boxes labeled X₁, X₁′, X₂, X₂′, X₃, X₃′, X₄, X₄′, X₅, X₅′, X₆, X₆′, then 5 green dots (ellipsis), then X_{N−2}, X_{N−2}′, X_{N−1}, X_{N−1}′ [?]. ~8 hollow white 3D block arrows point up into a full-width dark-purple bar 'Multi Head Self Attention Block' (white bold text). ~8 more white 3D arrows feed a row of 16 pale-yellow boxes labeled Ỹ₁, Y₁, Ỹ₂, Y₂, Ỹ₃, Y₃, Ỹ₄, Y₄, Ỹ₅, Y₅, Ỹ₆, Y₆, then 5 purple dots, then Ỹ_{N−2}, Y_{N−2}, Ỹ_{N−1}, Y_{N−1}. Short green up-arrows feed 8 red-orange ⊕ circles (white plus signs); orange curved skip-connection arrows rise from the Y row and enter each ⊕ from the left. A green dashed rounded rectangle groups this ⊕ row with the 'Layer Normalization' bar above it (orange bar; 'Layer' in red, 'Normalization' in dark brown). Green arrows continue up into a second identical 16-box Y row (5 purple dots). White 3D arrows rise into the Feed-Forward container (purple border, light-lavender fill) containing the header 'Feed Forward Networks [ One Hidden with  RELU Activation]' and 8 orange-bordered unit boxes, each depicting ~6 green neuron dots connected by thin lines to ~6 pink neuron dots with a tiny red 'RELU' label. Green arrows rise into a third identical 16-box Y row (5 purple dots), then green arrows feed a second row of 8 ⊕ circles with orange curved residual arrows, grouped by a second green dashed rounded rectangle with a second identical 'Layer Normalization' bar. Finally 8 red up-arrows cross the container's top edge into the OUTPUT row of 16 pale-yellow boxes labeled Ỹ₁, Y₁, Ỹ₂, Y₂, Ỹ₃, Y₃, Ỹ₄, Y₄, Ỹ₅, Y₅, Ỹ₆, Y₆, then 5 blue dots, then Ỹ_{N−2}, Y_{N−2}, Ỹ_{N−1}, Y_{N−1} [?].
